senses.sense_definition: To create a story or entertainment work as a series of connected parts.

examples.text: The author decided to <w>serialize</w> her new novel in a popular weekly magazine.
The studio plans to <w>serialize</w> the epic fantasy book into a ten-part television show.

senses.sense_definition: To release a book or story in regular, separate installments.

examples.text: Many classic Victorian novels were first <w>serialized</w> in newspapers before being published as books.
The magazine will <w>serialize</w> the biography over the next six months.

senses.sense_definition: To convert data into a format that can be stored or transmitted and later reconstructed.

examples.text: The program must <w>serialize</w> the user object before sending it across the network.
You need to <w>serialize</w> the data structure to save the current game state to a file.
